from omegaconf import OmegaConf
import pocket_coffea

# Get framework defaults
defaults = OmegaConf.structured(pocket_coffea.config.get_default_config())

# Load YAML parameter files
preselection_params = OmegaConf.load("params/object_preselection.yaml")
triggers_params = OmegaConf.load("params/triggers.yaml")

# Merge with precedence: defaults → object_preselection → triggers
config = OmegaConf.merge(defaults, preselection_params, triggers_params)

print(OmegaConf.to_yaml(config))
